siteTitle: Aravinth R | Senior Technical Support Engineer
name: Aravinth R
heroSummary: A **Senior Technical Support Engineer** and Product Support Analyst with 6+ years of experience supporting enterprise SaaS and healthcare technology applications for global customers.

paragraphs: Senior Technical Support Engineer with **6+ years of experience** supporting enterprise SaaS and healthcare technology applications for global customers.

Skilled in L2/L3 application and production support, ticket queue and SLA management, incident, problem and change management, root cause analysis, client communication, SQL-based data validation, REST API troubleshooting and log analysis.
Experienced in collaborating with Product, Development, QA and DevOps teams to resolve critical production issues, support UAT and releases, document repeatable processes and mentor support teams.

experiences.title: Senior Engineer, Tech Support
experiences.description: Provide advanced product and application support for enterprise SaaS and healthcare technology platforms, resolving complex application, configuration and data-related incidents for global clients. Manage escalations and collaborate with Product, Development, QA and DevOps teams on root cause analysis, workarounds and long-term solutions. Perform system validation, data investigation and configuration review, and communicate issue status, resolutions and next actions throughout the support lifecycle. Create knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides, mentor team members and identify recurring issues to improve reliability and support processes.

experiences.title: Issue Resolution Analyst (Application Support)
experiences.company: Athenahealth Technology Pvt Ltd, Chennai, India
experiences.description: Delivered L2/L3 application and production support, including on-call coverage, while managing high-volume JIRA and ServiceNow queues under ITSM processes and SLA targets. Diagnosed application, database, data and API issues using SQL queries, data validation, REST API testing with Insomnia and log analysis. Performed incident, problem and change management; completed root cause analysis and documented corrective actions to reduce repeat incidents. Supported release activities and UAT, and authored 40+ Confluence knowledge articles that reduced inbound tickets by 12%.

experiences.title: Senior AR Associate (Technical Support)
experiences.company: Guidehouse India Pvt Ltd, Trivandrum, India
experiences.description: Delivered application and production support through internal ticketing systems, prioritized and escalated incidents by severity, and maintained 98% SLA compliance for global customers.

experiences.title: Accounts Receivable Analyst (Support Analyst)
experiences.description: Performed SQL-based data validation and reporting and collaborated with technical teams on change initiatives, improving operational efficiency by 30%.
